title: Filtering the suppliers table by text

steps.title: Keep rows where name is Atlas Supply 1
steps.prompt:
WHERE is a sieve: only rows that pass the test stay.
Text values wear quotes, like 'Atlas Supply 1'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM suppliers WHERE name = 'Atlas Supply 1';
hints: Wrap the text value in single quotes.
Write: SELECT * FROM suppliers WHERE name = 'Atlas Supply 1';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM suppliers WHERE name = 'Atlas Supply 1';

steps.title: Search with LIKE for names starting 'Atl'
steps.prompt:
LIKE searches by pattern using the % wildcard.
Atl% means 'starts with'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM suppliers WHERE name LIKE 'Atl%';
hints: Write: SELECT * FROM suppliers WHERE name LIKE 'Atl%';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM suppliers WHERE name LIKE 'Atl%';

steps.title: Search with LIKE for 'tla' anywhere
steps.prompt:
Putting % on BOTH sides matches the text anywhere.
This %tla% means 'contains'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM suppliers WHERE name LIKE '%tla%';
hints: Wrap the text in %% on both sides.
Write: SELECT * FROM suppliers WHERE name LIKE '%tla%';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM suppliers WHERE name LIKE '%tla%';
